title: Green stage labels are too faint to read on a light background
context: You asked for finished stages to have green bars and green labels in the pass colour (#2F8F6B light, #5FC29C dark). The design expert's must-have rule (accessibility: small text needs at least 4.5:1 contrast) is not met by that green on a light background: #2F8F6B on white is 3.99:1, and on a light grey #F5F5F5 it is 3.66:1. Dark mode is fine (#5FC29C on dark is about 7:1), and the green bars and check mark pass the 3:1 rule for graphics. The labels are 9 px text. Today's grey labels are 4.25:1, also a little under. The two requests cannot both hold with this green.
